ranked_facts.concept_key: Immunohistochemical analysis for S100 protein and SOX10
ranked_facts.why: The strong positivity for S100 protein and SOX10 is more characteristic of gastrointestinal clear cell sarcoma than of gastrointestinal stromal tumor, metastatic neoplasm to the small intestine, or primary melanoma of the small intestine.

ranked_facts.concept_key: Microscopic examination of transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells
ranked_facts.why: The microscopic examination showing transmural, infiltrative proliferation of uniform epithelioid and spindle cells is more characteristic of gastrointestinal clear cell sarcoma than of gastrointestinal stromal tumor, metastatic neoplasm to the small intestine, or primary melanoma of the small intestine.
